mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_task WHERE goal_id = #{goalId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_task WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_task (goal_id, user_id, title, description, priority, status, due_date, estimated_minutes, sort_order, ai_generated, completed_at) VALUES (#{goalId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{dueDate}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{sortOrder}, #{aiGenerated}, #{completedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_task SET goal_id=#{goalId}, user_id=#{userId}, title=#{title}, description=#{description}, priority=#{priority}, status=#{status}, due_date=#{dueDate}, estimated_minutes=#{estimatedMinutes}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, ai_generated=#{aiGenerated}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
